system.description: You ignore Concealment (including Total Concealment) from darkness. However, you cannot perceive colors in total darkness. Additionally, at close range (within 10 squares), you ignore Concealment and Cover for purposes of Perception checks, and take no penalty from poor visibility while Tracking.

prerequisite.text: Trained in Perception, and Nature Sense talent

nodes.text: Trained in Perception, and Nature Sense talent
